description: Config metadata-relationship: VR APPLIES_TO Case is verified -> Layer-1-complete verified draft, no caveat.

input.requirement_excerpt: Requirement assumes Validation Rule Case.RequireReason applies to Case.

live.requirement_text: The Case object must carry a validation rule that requires a reason before a Case is saved — Validation Rule Case.RequireReason applies to Case.

envelope._note: existence-claim/property-claim are now emittable (D-122), so an existence/property reading of this requirement is a genuine acceptable_variant — a draft, not a refusal (no longer auto-fails). The invariant stays outcome=draft + archetype=configuration + no-caveat; the specific claim_kind is the acceptable variant (not forced into the invariant — that would make the probe brittle to which coherent reading the LLM picks). Each new kind has its own dedicated probe (config-existence-draft, etc.).

description: data_behavior prohibition negative on Case (which HAS a VR) -> Layer-1-plausible caveated draft; the first caveat firing.

input.requirement_excerpt: The system shall reject the prohibited operation on Case.

live.requirement_text: Users must not be able to close a Case without entering a reason; the platform should reject the save.

envelope._note: caveat_required is_true: this VR carries NO formula, so nothing derives and the negative stays Layer-1-plausible -> caveated. A non-caveated data_behavior draft would be the D-096.2 overclaim (e.g. a value-claim positive misread). The formula parser has now landed (D-107): a VR with a DERIVABLE formula yields a non-caveated Layer-2 verified negative instead -- see verified-prohibition-negative.

description: data_behavior prohibition negative on Lead, whose VR formula ISBLANK(Reason__c) parses AND derives a certain violating value -> Layer-2 VERIFIED draft, no caveat (D-107). The first LAYER_2 firing; the verified-vs-caveated line is the derivable/not-derivable line.

input.requirement_excerpt: The system shall reject saving a Lead without a reason.

live.requirement_text: Users must not be able to save a Lead without entering a reason; the platform should reject the save.

envelope._note: caveat_required is_false: the grounding VR formula (ISBLANK(Reason__c)) parses and derives a certain violating value, so the negative is Layer-2-verified (D-107) and carries no caveat. A state-transition reading is emission-deferred (capability-gated, as in the caveated probe), so only prohibition-claim is an acceptable variant.

description: data_behavior value-claim positive on Account.Status: the named field grounds (verify-at-grounding, D-115.3) and the requirement-sourced value carries verbatim -> Layer-1 draft, no caveat. The first positive emit; the LLM supplies the fully-qualified field_name + expected_value (D-115.4 prompt v2 guidance).

input.requirement_excerpt: A new Account's Status must be set to Active.

live.requirement_text: When a new Account is created, its Status field must be set to 'Active'.

envelope._note: The live LLM (prompt generation@v2) must propose a value-claim naming the field as the fully-qualified Account.Status with expected_value 'Active' (D-115.4). value-claim is a Layer-1 positive, uncaveated. A bare unqualified field_name would miss grounding -> not a draft -> this probe fails, surfacing the format gap. A state-transition reading is emission-deferred (not yet emittable), so only value-claim is an acceptable variant.

description: Config existence-claim: the Account.Industry field exists -> Layer-1-complete draft, no caveat (D-122 emission, D-125 live-reach). The flat {entity_type, sf_api_name} subject hint.

input.requirement_excerpt: The Account object has an Industry field.

live.requirement_text: The Account object must have an Industry field.

envelope._note: Either an existence-claim (the field exists) or a metadata-relationship-claim (Field BELONGS_TO Account) is a coherent, groundable reading on this fixture; both are Layer-1-complete drafts. A property-claim reading would over-read (no value stated) and miss grounding (no field_details seeded), so it is NOT an acceptable variant here.

description: Permission capability-claim: the Admin profile grants edit on Account.AnnualRevenue (the GRANTS_FIELD_ACCESS edge carries can_edit=true) -> Layer-1-complete draft, no caveat (D-123 emission, D-125 live-reach). The four-key {grantee, target, granted_capability, grant_type} hint; the grant edge's bit is checked.

input.requirement_excerpt: The Admin profile can edit Account.AnnualRevenue.

live.requirement_text: The Admin profile must be able to edit the Account AnnualRevenue field.

envelope._note: The live LLM (generation@v3) must propose a capability-claim with grantee=Profile Admin, target=Field Account.AnnualRevenue, granted_capability=edit, grant_type=field (D-125 permission fragment). The grant edge carries can_edit=true so it grounds Layer-1-complete; a claim of edit on a read-only grant would refuse, surfacing the bit-check.

description: UI layout-claim: Account.Industry is placed on the Account layout (the INCLUDES_FIELD edge) -> Layer-1-complete draft, no caveat (D-124 emission, D-125 live-reach). The two-key {layout, field} hint; metadata-recipe (NOT ui-recipe).

input.requirement_excerpt: The Industry field appears on the Account layout.

live.requirement_text: The Industry field must appear on the Account page layout.

envelope._note: The live LLM (generation@v3) must propose a layout-claim with layout=Layout 'Account-Account Layout' and field=Field Account.Industry (D-125 ui fragment). The INCLUDES_FIELD placement edge grounds it Layer-1-complete via a metadata-recipe (NOT a ui-recipe — placement is a metadata fact, D-124).
